def transform(grid):
    """Turn the background into the object's color and the object into 0."""
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    object_color = next(value for value, _ in counts.most_common() if value != background)
    return [[object_color if value == background else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
